LanguageData.DMS_DeviantRefuge_ArrivedText: {DEVIANT_nameFull} has arrived and joined the colony.\n\n{DEVIANT_pronoun} has begun restoring the encrypted archive, which should take {DAYS} days. Until then, {FLEET} does not know {DEVIANT_nameDef} is here.
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantRefuge_HandoverInfoTip: The encrypted archive will be restored on {0}, and the colonial fleet will then demand the deviant's extradition.
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantRefuge_HandoverText:
{DEVIANT_nameFull} has kept {DEVIANT_possessive} word and handed over the restored encrypted files:

{GRANTED}

At the same moment, {FLEET} has come to regard us as harboring a defector, and has turned hostile.

The fleet will not let it go. As long as {DEVIANT_nameDef} stays with the colony, hunting parties will keep coming.
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantRefuge_DeferredInfo: Hostility takes effect once the court-martial ends
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantRefuge_HostilityText: The court-martial is over, and the truce with it. {FLEET} has turned hostile, citing our harboring of a defector.\n\nThe fleet will not let it go. As long as {DEVIANT_nameDef} stays with the colony, hunting parties will keep coming.
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantExtradition_LetterText:
{DEVIANT_nameFull} has finished restoring the archive, but at the same moment {FLEET} has learned that we are sheltering {DEVIANT_nameDef}. The military police command has served us a formal extradition demand.

Hand {DEVIANT_objective} over:
{REWARDS}
The fleet will confiscate the encrypted archive.

Refuse: {DEVIANT_nameDef} hands the restored files over to us, and {FLEET} turns hostile and keeps sending hunters after {DEVIANT_objective} until {DEVIANT_pronoun} dies or is banished from the colony.

If we give no answer within {DAYS}, the fleet will take it as a refusal.
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantExtradition_RewardHonor: - {AMOUNT} {HONOR} for a colonist of our choosing, toward a fleet rank
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantExtradition_RewardMood: - Our colonists will be upset at having handed over one of their own
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantExtradition_DeadlineInfoTip: If we give no answer in time, the fleet will take it as a refusal.
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantExtradition_SilenceMessage: We never answered {FLEET}'s extradition demand. The fleet has taken it as a refusal.
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantExtradition_DoneText: A fleet orbital transport has taken {DEVIANT_nameFull} away, along with the encrypted archive. {FLEET} has acknowledged our cooperation.\n\nNo one knows what awaits {DEVIANT_objective} now.
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantExtradition_HonorText: {FLEET} credits us with the extradition and offers {AMOUNT} {HONOR}. Who should receive it?
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantRefuge_PendingLine: - {PROJECT} (data received; decoded automatically once {PREREQS} is researched)
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantRefuge_NothingGranted: (nothing in the archive was new to the colony)
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantRefuge_PendingDecodedText: With the prerequisite research complete, our researchers can finally read the {PROJECT} file the deviant left behind.
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantRefuge_FailedDiedText: {DEVIANT_nameFull} died before the restoration was finished, and the encrypted archive lost the only key that could read it.\n\nThe fleet never learned {DEVIANT_pronoun} had been here.
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantRefuge_FailedLeftText: {DEVIANT_nameFull} left the colony before the restoration was finished, taking the encrypted archive along.
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantRefuge_FailedKidnappedText: {DEVIANT_nameFull} was carried off before the restoration was finished, and the encrypted archive went missing along with {DEVIANT_objective}.
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantRefuge_FailedNoArrivalText: {DEVIANT_nameFull} never made it to the colony, and we have heard nothing from {DEVIANT_objective} since.
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantHunt_EndedDiedText: {DEVIANT_nameFull} is dead. {FLEET} has struck the defector from its rolls, and no more hunters will come.\n\nThe hostility with the fleet does not end with it.
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantHunt_EndedLeftText: {DEVIANT_nameFull} is no longer with the colony. {FLEET} has moved its hunt elsewhere and will stop sending hunters after us.\n\nThe hostility with the fleet does not end with it.
LanguageData.DMS_DeviantHunt_GoodwillBlocked: The colony still harbors a deviant hunted by {FLEET}. Relations with the fleet cannot improve.
LanguageData.DMS_Occultech_RenounceBlockedDeviant: We are still sheltering a deviant the fleet is hunting. They will not accept any declaration from us.
LanguageData.DMS_HuntBreaker_SuspendedTextDeviant:
{NODE_definite} has been destroyed.

Without it, {FLEET}'s radar tracking and navigation network on this planet has a gaping hole in it. They have lost track of the deviant, and the hunt has been called off.

This will not last. Another computer on the SAGE network will take over the node's work sooner or later; the hunt should start again in about {DURATION}.

Note: as long as we shelter the deviant, our hostility with the fleet will not be lifted.
LanguageData.DMS_HuntBreaker_SuspendedDeviantLine: The hunt we brought on ourselves by sheltering the deviant has been broken off as well, and will resume at the same time.
